text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "There are other simple ways of keeping cool during periods of hot weather: shading windows, turning off unused appliances and lights (sources of heat!), airing rooms thoroughly in the morning, then keeping the windows closed.", "gist": "Alternative methods to stay cool in hot weather include shading windows, turning off unused appliances and lights, airing rooms in the morning, and closing windows afterwards."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Ventilators are relatively inexpensive and consume less energy than air conditioning units, and they keep the air flowing and thus help cool the room.", "gist": "Ventilators are cheaper and more energy-efficient than air conditioners and help cool rooms by circulating air."}]}
